requirements.quote: A token sent in a NEW_TOKEN frame or a Retry packet MUST be constructed in a way that allows the server to identify how it was provided to a client.
requirements.condition: When constructing a token to be sent in a NEW_TOKEN frame or a Retry packet.
requirements.required_behavior: Construct the token so that the server can identify whether and how it was provided to the client.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not construct the token in a form that prevents the server from identifying how it was provided to the client.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation test can generate tokens through both delivery mechanisms and verify that the server can distinguish their provenance and apply mechanism-specific handling.
